title: Household Allowances on Loop+ Membership Plans
content:
Each Loop+ Membership plan sets how many additional people the owner may share benefits with: additional adults who may share benefits, and teen sub-accounts who may share shipping benefits. Both are whole numbers.

| Plan | Additional adults who may share benefits | Teen sub-accounts who may share shipping benefits |
|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | 0 | 0 |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | 0 | 0 |
| Loop+ Student Annual | 0 | 0 |
| Loop+ Monthly | 1 | 0 |
| Loop+ Annual | 1 | 0 |
| Loop+ Household Annual | 1 | 4 |

**Q. Which Loop+ plans allow an additional adult?**
Loop+ Monthly, Loop+ Annual and Loop+ Household Annual each allow 1 additional adult. Loop+ Access Monthly and the two student plans allow 0.

**Q. Which Loop+ plan allows teen sub-accounts?**
Only Loop+ Household Annual, which allows 4 teen sub-accounts to share shipping benefits. Every other plan allows 0.

**Q. Does Loop+ Household Annual allow more adults than Loop+ Annual?**
No. Both allow 1 additional adult; the plans differ in teen sub-accounts, 4 against 0.
